n: Code.org AI and Machine Learning lesson 5: Classification Models
t: A 45-minute unplugged lesson where students draw a boundary between fruits and veggies.
steps: Find Lesson 5 Classification Models in the Code.org AI and Machine Learning course.
Review the lesson plan and the teacher PDF.
Cut out one set of fruit and veggie cards per group.
Copy the slides and the activity guide.
Note that a deprecation notice appears on related pages for the CS in Algebra course.
Run the journal warm up and then the graphing activity.
